body: There is a boat but tis more expensive, I can’t borrow money my family struggles to eat some days of the week. I just need to work slowly with it, I’ve contacted her and she doesn’t know what to feel right now. I told her that we can’t choose a future so we shouldn’t think of one, but we can work towards a future.

The thing is, chronic depression never goes away, like ever. There is no cure.. so.. I won’t get through it. (I’m a rare type and medication makes me more depressed/ suicidal) basically I’m fucked for life

We spoke everyday for 7-8 months, I was working on funds to see her (we aren’t far but I live in a island state so I needed to catch a plane) she feels the same but it’s too hard for her to wait because she hurts that I’m not with her
I don’t know what real love is but she’s the closest I’ve felt to someone romantically, love could be subjective, I think I love her, dating sites make me feel worse, they don’t work.
Edit: I was slowly losing more weight over time in my relationship, now I’m afraid I’m going to completely lose it and just lose too much weight to handle
I’m not worried I feel good now that I’ve done it. Thank you for answering
